description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — triggers a new deployment from a source archive URL (a tar.gz reachable by Scalingo). To roll back, re-deploy a previous git_ref/archive — there is no separate rollback endpoint. Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/deployments. Returns { deployment }.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

git_ref.description: Optional git reference label for the deployment (branch/tag/SHA).

source_url.description: URL of the source archive (tar.gz) Scalingo should build and deploy.

name: trigger_deployment
title: Trigger a deployment
